genius_advantages.point: Loyalty is newly acquired (Spendgo, ~120 brands) — integration still in progress in 2026
Stock fell >65% during 4 years public before take-private
No longer discloses financials post take-private

competitor_advantages.point: Dominant enterprise digital-ordering footprint; ~65% of Olo customers already run loyalty programs (cross-sell base)
"Loyalty is foundational to guest engagement, and bringing this in-house lets us move faster" (Noah Glass, CEO)
Payments partners Stripe and FreedomPay for in-store (Feb 2025)

latest_cos_commentary.headline: Olo spans direct ordering, delivery and payments/loyalty adjacency at multi-unit brands.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Olo spans direct ordering, delivery and payments/loyalty adjacency at multi-unit brands.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Olo announced on September 23 that Scooter’s Coffee digital ordering now runs on Olo and added a first delivery channel. Latest check: Olo’s Winter 2026 release states Olo Loyalty is available, with deeper integration planned.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Map ordering and delivery orchestration by account before pitching overlapping Genius components.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: The pack labels Olo as Loyalty; its primary category here is digital commerce and ordering. Availability and planned integration should not be conflated with customer adoption.
